notes.title: SOPA - Tale of the Stolen Potato has a release date!
notes.content: [p]Grab a bowl of SOPA and enter this magical world of adventures, frogs, and mischief on October 7th!! 👵🐸[/p][p]Described by the Guardian, VICE, and IGN Japan as "a game that feels like playing a Pixar movie", and inspired by Miyazaki, Coco, and the Little Prince, SOPA is a heartwarming narrative adventure about the things that we pass along set in the distant fantastical lands of South America.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="rzYpb3OnaUk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]"It's like soup; warm and comforting, and exactly what I want" - The Indie Council.[/p]

notes.content: [p]We're super excited to be part of the first edition of the Debut Festival, which aims to promote studios working on their first video game.[/p][p]SOPA will be featured alongside other great debut titles. Don't hesitate to join us and get a taste of what's coming![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42124849/caee945e2691e1918de8d448171e114e2e399319.png"][/img][/p][p]The event is organized by GameDev.ist and kicks off on August 7th. We look forward to seeing you there tomorrow![/p][p][/p][p]Con mucho cariño, [/p][p]- Team StudioBando[/p]

notes.title: SOPA is part of the LAGS - Gamescom LATAM showcase!
notes.content:
Hello Folks!

We're thrilled to be featured once again at the Latin American Games Showcase, this time in collaboration with Gamescom LATAM! Join us to explore the exciting developments happening across the region.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42124849/e6330dc089dca6603c5cbdcd54e8c1b30814325c.png[/img]

Stay tuned to their [url=https://www.twitch.tv/lagshowcase]Twitch [/url]and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@lagshowcase]YouTube [/url]channels! We look forward to seeing you (virtually) there on May 2nd. Catch SOPA at the stream and get a glimpse into the most exciting games in the region!

Con mucho cariño,
- Team StudioBando

notes.title: SOPA is a finalist for Best Game - Latin America in Gamescom Latam!
notes.content:
Hello Folks!

We're thrilled to be to be nominated for Best Game - Latin America at this year's edition of Gamescom Latam! We're very excited of being part of such a great event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42124849/b207462b1afcb4410197ad8e9141913d5e13f23a.png[/img]

The event will take place in São Paulo from April 30, 2025, to Sunday, May 4. If you happen to be around, come say hi to the dev team!

Con mucho cariño,
- Team StudioBando

notes.title: We’re in the Latin American Games Showcase!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It’s Juan from StudioBando, and I have super exciting news for you all today: SOPA - Tale of the Stolen Potato is part of the[b] Latin American Games Showcase - The Game Awards Edition 2024!![/b]

Be sure to check out the awesome LAGS stream to get a glimpse into the most exciting projects coming out of Latin America, and get a taste of SOPA, our emotional narrative adventure inspired by Spirited Away, Coco, and The Little Prince!

The demo’s got it all: frogs, pandas, dolphins, shady characters! A sweet grandma! One potato! The list goes on, but you’ll have to play to find out the rest :)

We really hope you enjoy it and that it warms your heart at least a little. :) Let us know what you think here or on our [url=https://x.com/StudioBando]socials[/url]. 

[previewyoutube=LRBFWAOPE5k;full][/previewyoutube]

Con mucho amor,
Juan & Team StudioBando

notes.title: SOPA coming to Adventure X
notes.content:
Hello Folks!

We're thrilled to be part of this year's digital edition of Adventure X, The Narrative Games Convention!
that means you can attend the event from wherever you are!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42124849/c68720c57f5660927a4a7c3a1ff7315200050fb7.png[/img]

notes.title: You can try SOPA RIGHT NOW, demo out now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It’s Juan from StudioBando and today is a super special day: the Steam Next Fest is kicking off and SOPA is part of it with our first demo :D 

You can try it right now on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1935330/SOPA__Tale_of_the_Stolen_Potato/]Steam page![/url]

[previewyoutube=Bij_O7ppcRg;full][/previewyoutube]

The demo is around 30 minutes long (depending on how much time you spend exploring) and will give you a good sneak peek of the game. The demo’s got it all: frogs, pandas, dolphins, shady characters! A sweet grandma! One potato! The list goes on, but you’ll have to play to find out the rest.

We really hope you enjoy it and that it warms your heart at least a little. :) And please let us know what you think here in the Steam forums and on socials.

Con mucho amor,
StudioBando

notes.title: Sneak Demo Preview GDoC Developer Stream
notes.content:
Welcome folks! Hope you enjoy this exciting tour of our upcoming demo for SOPA - Tale of the Stolen Potato, where Creative Director Juan will be sharing glimpses into the making of SOPA, our inspirations, and major references, in this exclusive stream for GDoC!

Learn about the design of Nana's house and discover new footage showcasing some of the most recent additions to the game that we hope will make you feel at adventurous, warm, and curious! (all at the same time!)

Catch us during the GDoC Expo, ending tomorrow, Sat 21st in the evening!!

Thanks for joining and hope you enjoy!
- Team Bando
